page.layout: One page. Running head at top, with page number 301 at top right. Below it a caption line running across the full width. Below that a column-header block, then one table of 37 rows in four to six columns: years before Julian reckoning, Augustan numeral, Olympiad year, Urbs-condita year, letters, and Nabonassar year with weekday and notes. The rows are the table body. No margin text, no footnotes.

main_text.head: tione temporum, diuersis respondent mensib.[?]Iulianis.
main_text.l: Anni ante ordin.Iul. | Aur. num. | Anni Olympiadici | An.Vrb. conditæ | Literæ domin. | Nabonas. | Feriæ fari.

page.notes: The header line "Nabona-" and "fari." are split across two lines; the column label between "Literæ domin." and "Feriæ" is read as Nabonassar and is doubtful. Row 371 reads ":5 Nou.3", with an uncertain colon. The dashes in the Feriæ column are leader lines, and the entries "Nou." are the new-moon notes printed in the same column. The entries "17—I" (row 323) and "16—I" (row 304) are printed as one cell with a dash and are unclear. The caption word "mensib." is printed "mesib." or similar and is marked [?]. Dash leaders are not transcribed.
